name: Codex Meter
description:
Track your Codex usage limits from the panel. See remaining quota, resets times, usage trends, and estimates of whether your quota will last until it resets.

Redeem banked resets directly, or enable automatic redemption before expiry or when remaining quota runs low.

Uses your existing Codex CLI or ChatGPT desktop credentials.

*Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.*
